explanation: Fires only at the GO step when the agent chooses a2 (always 0 at D1, at D2 and when it chooses a1): about 10 if the previous trial reached S2 and was rewarded, about 3 if the previous trial reached S2 but went unrewarded right after a win (or reached S1 by a rare transition and was rewarded), and 0 after two losses in a row or after a rare unrewarded trial. The peak gets weaker as the episode goes on: about 10 in trials 0-20, 7-8 around trials 25-50 and about 3 after trial 60.
